value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "Such partnerships require sustained engagement rather than one-time interactions, positioning teachers as co-learners and co-designers who can facilitate their students' legitimate peripheral participation in scientific communities."
